title: Grade 1 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #4

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand.
   B. Apply the teaching of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:.
   C. Use Hadith on: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on: has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN.
   B. Say Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Islamic etiquettes has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes.
   D. Use Islamic etiquettes to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Birth of Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Use Birth of Prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Birth of Prophet.
   C. Say Birth of Prophet has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Birth of Prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Environment School cleanliness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment School cleanliness.
   B. Use Environment School cleanliness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Environment School cleanliness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Environment School cleanliness has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic phrases? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic phrases.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic phrases with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic phrases to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic phrases has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Love for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Love for parents with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Love for parents has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Love for parents.
   D. Use Love for parents to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Birth of Prophet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. B — Apply the teaching of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Birth of Prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

10. C — Apply the teaching of Environment School cleanliness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic phrases with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Love for parents with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Surah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Birth of Prophet; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
